mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_insight ( member_id, insight_type, period, category, current_amount, previous_amount, change_rate, summary, detail_data ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{insightType}, #{period}, #{category}, #{currentAmount}, #{previousAmount}, #{changeRate}, #{summary}, #{detailData} )
mapper.select: SELECT insight_id, member_id, insight_type, period, category, current_amount, previous_amount, change_rate, summary, detail_data, created_at FROM ai_insight WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT insight_id, member_id, insight_type, period, category, current_amount, previous_amount, change_rate, summary, detail_data, created_at FROM ai_insight WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND insight_type = #{insightType} AND period = #{period} AND category IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT insight_id, member_id, insight_type, period, category, current_amount, previous_amount, change_rate, summary, detail_data, created_at FROM ai_insight WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND period = #{period} AND category = #{category} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT insight_id, member_id, insight_type, period, category, current_amount, previous_amount, change_rate, summary, detail_data, created_at FROM ai_insight WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND insight_type = 'MONTHLY' AND period LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '%') ORDER BY period DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT insight_id, member_id, insight_type, period, category, current_amount, previous_amount, change_rate, summary, detail_data, created_at FROM ai_insight WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND insight_type = 'WEEKLY' AND period LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '-W%') ORDER BY period DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_insight SET current_amount = #{currentAmount}, previous_amount = #{previousAmount}, change_rate = #{changeRate}, summary = #{summary}, detail_data = #{detailData} WHERE insight_id = #{insightId}
